ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring and land compliance platform designed to track industrial expansion and zoning violations in Coahuila manufacturing corridors.
ideas.title: SaltilloAutoCompliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture that won the Xcelerate Hackathon by combining geospatial data with automated computer vision to solve local industrial oversight problems.

ideas.pitch: AWS-powered risk detection and investigation platform tailored for local maquiladora supply chains, combining graph intelligence and anomaly detection.
ideas.title: CoahuilaSupplyChainAML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy enterprise tooling and graph intelligence to solve a concrete financial and logistics compliance issue relevant to industrial border regions.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and GAM-based forecasting tool predicting regional agricultural yield disruptions and climate incident risks in northern Mexico.
ideas.title: NorteAgroForecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine mathematical and statistical rigor rather than a basic wrapper, matching the winning formula of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and institutional RAG platform built with LangGraph to automate administrative navigation and academic resource allocation.
ideas.title: TecNMSmartCampusRAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses campus administrative friction at TecNM using state-of-the-art multi-agent orchestration, following the GreenNovation Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven nutrition and personalized meal planning assistant optimized for local traditional Mexican ingredients, dietary restrictions, and regional markets.
ideas.title: LocalBitesSaltillo
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate consumer utility with localized personalization, matching the rapid scoping and execution profile of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon winner.
